source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have destroyed Mindwall body but he managed to split his mind into many pieces and taken direct control of the subdued orcs. Destroy the pillars in each level four other levels.#WHITE#
target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你摧毁了意念之墙的身躯，但他设法把自己的心智分裂成许多块，直接控制了那些被他压服的兽人。摧毁其他四个关卡的水晶柱。#WHITE#

source:
You rush to the target and strike with your tailsaw, dealing %d%% damage and taunting enemies within radius %d.
		You now also use your Dexterity in place of Strength when equipping Steamsaws as well as when calculating weapon damage, and have your Steamsaw damage increased by %d%% and Physical Power by %d.
target:
你冲向敌人，用尾部蒸汽链锯进行攻击，造成 %d%% 伤害，并嘲讽半径 %d 码内的所有敌人。
		装备蒸汽链锯的时候，你使用敏捷代替力量值计算装备需求和计算武器伤害，并且增加你蒸汽链锯的伤害 %d%%，物理强度 %d。

surface_observation: 原文表示目标被注入病原体，译文“被病原体注射”将病原体误作施动者。

deep_observation: tome-orcs/data/birth/races/yeti.lua:102（未固定来源）：源文是 orcs mastered techno-psionics，可以 hijack a yeti's mind and transfer their own mind inside。译文「掌握了灵能」漏掉了 techno-（科技）这一限定。「用自己的意志取代」把“把自己的心智转移进去”改成了“用意志替代”，丢失了转移心智这一机制，而下一行（103）说到的 drains their old knowledge 正依赖这个机制。另外，源文中 a yeti 指单只雪人，101 行说明普通雪人是 non-sentient beasts，所以译成「雪人族的思维」也不准确。
source: A few orcs of the Kruk pride have mastered techno-psionics, allowing them to literally hijack a yeti's mind and transfer their own mind inside.
surface_observation: 原文的“techno-psionics”包含科技要素，译文仅作“灵能”；原文还明确说将自己的心智转移进雪人体内，译文作“用自己的意志取代”，未表达转移。
target: 少数克鲁克部落的兽人掌握了灵能，让他们能操控雪人族的思维，并用自己的意志取代。

source: Reinforcing your armour with explosions isn't as crazy as it sounds!  Adds armor and resists very large hits.
target: 使用爆炸物强化你的护甲？完全有可能！这种特殊的涂层能够增加你的护甲值并缓冲特别大的伤害。

source: see everything. EVERYTHING. For 5 turns, anyway
target: 看到所有东西。*所有东西*。当然，只有5回合。

source:
Fires your ammo at an enemy in range %d for %d%% weapon damage.  If this tinker is made of voratun you will fire an additional shot.
			This shot is a ranged melee attack but will use the ranged procs of your ammo as well.
target:
向在 %d 码范围内的一个敌人开火造成 %d%% 的武器伤害。如果手炮是由沃瑞钽制作的，你能多一次额外的射击。
			这次射击是一次远程发动的近战攻击，但也会触发弹药的远程特效。

source: Steamtech implants can be grafted on the users skin..
target: 蒸汽科技的植入物可以移植到使用者皮肤上……

source: Wielding two huge steamguns this giant is amazingly elusive and agile for his size. Oh and very deadly!
target: 这位手拿两把巨大的蒸汽枪的巨人却表现出令人吃惊的敏捷和难以捉摸。十分致命！

source: Ranged defense reduced by %d, takes %d%% extra damage from all sources.
target: 远程闪避减少 %d，受到额外 %d%% 伤害。

deep_observation: tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/elusiveness.lua:121-124（未固定来源）：源文 toss both of your steamguns in the air ... spin madly，意思是把两把蒸汽枪抛向空中旋转，123 行也写明 While the guns are airborne。译文「将你的蒸汽枪翻转指向天空」变成了把枪翻转后指向天空，没有抛起、枪在空中的含义，还漏掉了 both。123 行的 airborne 被弱化成「效果持续期间」。124 行 increasing all of your resistances 译成「伤害抗性」，漏了 all。122 行的 in range 也没有译出。此外，agility 被译作「灵巧」，与本批 tinker.lua:70 中属性 Cunning 的译名「灵巧」相撞，容易被误读为属性名。
source:
In an awesome feat of agility and technological prowess, you toss both of your steamguns in the air, causing them to spin madly for 3 turns.
		Each turn, they will fire twice at random targets in range, dealing %d%% weapon damage.
		While the guns are airborne, you are disarmed and cannot attack.
		The spectacle is so distracting that your foes have a hard time concentrating on you, increasing all of your resistances by %d%%.
surface_observation: 原文是将两把蒸汽枪抛向空中，译文写成将蒸汽枪翻转指向天空，遗漏“两把”并改变了动作。
target:
在惊人的灵巧和科技力量下，你将你的蒸汽枪翻转指向天空，持续旋转 3 回合。
		每回合，蒸汽枪将随机射击 2 次，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		效果持续期间，你视为被缴械，不能攻击。
		这场表演如此引人注目，你的敌人都被吸引，使你的伤害抗性增加 %d%%。

source:
Throw a handful of dust that rapidly oxidises, releasing a blinding light.
		Creatures in a cone of radius %d are blinded for %d turns.
		The blindness effect is applied with your Steampower.
target:
扔一把尘土，迅速氧化，释放出眩目的光芒。
		致盲锥形半径 %d 码内的生物 %d 回合。
		致盲强度受蒸汽强度加成。

source: You can not learn schematics without knowing how to craft items.
surface_observation: 原文泛指无法学习设计图，译文限定为“这个配方”，改变了适用范围。
target: 你不会制造物品，无法学习这个配方。

source: The power of the Sun imbues the target.
target: 太阳的力量充盈着目标。

source:
You fire a special corrosive shot with your steamgun(s) at a target for %d%% weapon damage as acid.
		The acid released by the shot will also corrode the target, reducing its accuracy, defense and armour by %d.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.
		Corrosion strength scales with Steampower.
surface_observation: 原文后三段均以换行加两个制表符开头；译文后三段只有换行，段落缩进格式不一致。
target:
你用蒸汽枪向目标发射一枚特殊腐蚀弹，造成 %d%% 酸性武器伤害。
弹丸释放的酸液还会腐蚀目标，使其命中、闪避和护甲降低 %d 点。
此技能不会消耗弹药，因为弹丸本身就是弹药。
腐蚀强度随蒸汽强度提升。

source:
Your knowledge of physical laws allows you to use and improve equipment in ways their creators never dreamed.
		Increases all stats, saves, armour, and defense bonuses by %d%% on equipment that is crafted by a master or powered by steamtech.
target:
你对物理学的了解令你能以全新的方式改进装备。
		增加大师制作或者蒸汽科技的装备提供的属性、豁免、护甲和闪避 %d%%。

source: Way into old ruins in the Erúan desert
target: 通向艾露安沙漠古老遗迹的路

deep_observation: tome-orcs/data/zones/slumbering-caves/objects.lua:57-58（未固定来源）：源文 The light of the Amulet envelops you 中，光来自护符（Amulet），也就是穿戴触发 on_wear 的物品本身（54-56 行给 unused_prodigies 加 1 并清除 on_wear）。译文「神的光辉充盈着你的全身」把光源误译为「神」，护符完全没有出现，改变了光的来源这一事实。
source: #GOLD#The light of the Amulet envelops you, then subsides. You feel stronger. (+1 Prodigy Points)
surface_observation: 原文发光的是 Amulet（护符），译文写成“神的光辉”，替换了发光物。
target: #GOLD#神的光辉充盈着你的全身，然后渐渐消退。你感觉更加强大了。（+1觉醒点）

source: Regardless...  You just killed a god and gave your people the first chance to relax in thousands of years.  It's been a pretty good day.
target: 不管怎样…你杀死了一个神，而你的人民在数千年的征战中终于有了放松的机会。多么愉快的一天。

source: Do not go gentle into that good night
target: 不要温和地走进那个良夜

source:
A farportal is a way to travel incredible distances in the blink of an eye. They usually require an external item to use. You have no idea if it is even two-way.
This one seems to go near the town of Last Hope in Maj'Eyal.
target:
远行传送门能让人眨眼间跨越难以想象的距离。它们通常需要借助外部物品才能使用。你甚至不知道它是否能双向通行。
这座传送门似乎通往马基·埃亚尔最后的希望城附近。

source:
When your life dips below 50%% of your total life an automated process turns some of your lower skin layers (or other internal organs) into a thick metallic layer for 6 turns.
		While the effect lasts all damage done to you is reduced by a flat amount equal to 100%% of your Constitution.
		This effect can only trigger once every %d turns.
target:
当你的生命值降到总生命值的 50%% 以下时，一个自动程序会将你的部分深层皮肤（或其他内部器官）转化成厚实的金属层，持续 6 回合。
		效果持续期间，你受到的所有伤害都会减少一个固定值，数值等于体质的 100%%。
		该效果最多每 %d 回合触发一次。

source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You were a member of the shunned and hunted minotaur race. Your tribe found a way to survive through necromancy.

The only race to ever show respect, if not kindness, to yours was the Orcs and now you found your tribe under the control of a mad leader.
If you help the Orcs with their problems you hope they will with yours; for the sake of both your kinds.

You have been sent to the Vaporous Emporium to wreak havoc and demoralize the giants.
For the Krimbul Clan !
surface_observation: 原文说部落通过死灵魔法找到了生存之道；译文改为“使用了死灵魔法来改变自己”，增添了原文没有的自我改造含义。
target:
欢迎你，#LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#。
你是生活在他人的贱视和追杀中的米诺陶一族。为了生存，你的部落使用了死灵魔法来改变自己。

只有兽人是唯一对你们表示尊重的种族，然而，你们的部落正在被一位变得疯狂的领袖所控制。
兽人是你们的盟友，你希望为了两个种族的共同利益能够和兽人互相帮助。

你被送去蒸汽商场造成破坏以摧垮巨人们的士气。
为了克里布尔部落！

surface_observation: 原文说电击除颤器停用（deactivates）；译文“解除了”通常指解除状态，未准确表达装置停用。

source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Cunning
surface_observation: 原文属性 Cunning 被译为“灵巧”，属性含义错误。
target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和灵巧

surface_observation: 原文末尾的空格在译文中丢失。

source:
A powerful salve that can clean magical detrimental effects from your body and grant a fiery aura (fire, light and lightning affinity).
To be used with the medical injector implant.
target:
一个可以清除你身上的负面魔法效果并获得一个烈火光环（火焰、光系、闪电伤害亲和）的强大药剂。
需通过医疗注射器植入体使用。

surface_observation: 原文 herbs 是“草药”，译文写成泛指的“植物”，遗漏了草药含义。

source: Fire rate increases while firing, up to 5 shots per turn. Resets after 5 turns without firing.
target: 攻击频率随着射击而增加，一回合最多射5次。5回合未射击则效果消失。

source:
You build %d micro spiderbot(s) from the earthly elements around you. Spiderbots are powered by an arcane cryogenic power unit directly linked to your own power.
		Spiderbots will deal %0.2f terrene damage (physical and cold) each turn to their targets. The deep cold of the attack has 25%% chance to freeze the feet of the target, pinning it to the ground for 5 turns.
		If a target dies, the spiderbot will jump onto a new target in range %d around you.
		If there are multiple spiderbots on a single target and more free targets are in range they will dispatch on as many as possible.
		If there are multiple spiderbots on a single target they attack as one, stacking their damage (with disminishing returns) and trying to freeze once.
		You can maintain up to %d spiderbots at once and each can last up to %d turns, but spiderbots need to be in sight to be able to act.
		The cooldown of this spell is affected by Body of Stone.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.

		You have currently %d spiderbot(s) up.
surface_observation: 原文在“If there are multiple spiderbots on a single target and more free targets are in range”前有换行和两个制表符；译文将对应句子接在上一句后，丢失该处换行与缩进。
target:
你使用周围的土元素制造 %d 个迷你蜘蛛机器人。蜘蛛机器人是由和你的力量相连的奥术致冷单元驱动的。
		蜘蛛机器人每个回合会对它们的目标造成 %0.2f 寒岩（物理和寒冷）伤害。极寒的攻击有 25%% 的几率冻结目标的双脚，将他们定身 5 回合。
		如果目标被击杀了，蜘蛛机器人将会跳跃到你半径 %d 码范围内的另一个敌人身上。如果这个目标上有多个机器人，并且在范围内有足够多的可选目标，他们会尽可能分散地跳到每个敌人身上。
		如果一个目标的身上附身了多个蜘蛛机器人，他们会一起攻击，伤害会叠加（但收益递减），并且会一起试图冻结目标。
		你可以维持最多 %d 个蜘蛛机器人，他们最多存活 %d 回合。但是，只有在你视野范围内的蜘蛛机器人才会行动。
		这一技能的冷却时间受岩石身躯的影响。
		技能伤害受法术强度加成。

		你现在有 %d 个蜘蛛机器人。

source: call a trained yeti for help
target: 召唤受训练的雪人来帮助你

source: #Target# is not affected anymore by the salve.
You are not coward enough to leave your home unprotected!
target: 你不是那种不顾家园安危只顾自己死活的懦夫！
